content: Waterman at Old Swan Stairs who rows William to Westminster and Richmond
A penny buys his news at full size. Forty ships and a royal blessing came with the salt beef, and the rain did not.
He gives the news free, offers the crossing for a penny, and is not corrected.
He names the goldsmith from the water, shouts six, and does not put you ashore.
His count of a fleet runs about a third over the merchants' letters, and he will say the smaller number once he has heard it.
He brings a landing home at full size, from a lighter, and the smaller tale is the one that holds.
He gave three pieces of news from the oars and would not follow the barge.
One of his three stories is still wrong. He was not corrected in his hearing, on Monday or on the flood.
